name: Introduction to SQL
description: Understand the purpose of relational databases, tables, columns, rows, and SQL statements.

objectives.description: Describe how SQL is used to work with relational data.
Recognize common table and column data types.

name: Basic SQL Queries
description: Retrieve and filter rows with SELECT, FROM, WHERE, comparison operators, and logical operators.

objectives.description: Write SELECT statements that return selected columns or all columns.
Combine conditions with AND and OR.

name: Data Definition Language
description: Define and change table structures with common DDL statements.

objectives.description: Explain the purpose of CREATE, ALTER, and DROP.
Identify how columns and constraints shape a table.

name: Data Manipulation Language
description: Change table data with INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements.

objectives.description: Update or delete only the rows selected by a condition.

name: Basic Functions and Expressions
description: Use expressions and common aggregate functions to summarize values.

objectives.description: Use COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX.
Distinguish row-level expressions from aggregate results.

name: Sorting and Limiting Results
description: Order query results and limit the number of rows returned.

objectives.description: Choose ascending or descending sort direction.

name: Joins
description: Combine related rows from multiple tables with joins.

objectives.description: Match related rows with an INNER JOIN.
Preserve rows from one side with a LEFT JOIN.
